h1: Window cleaning in West Cypress Hills
h1_em: A big community, one clear view.
intro: West Cypress Hills is a master planned Lake Travis ISD community south of TX 71 at Bee Creek Road, with more than 1,000 homes. CleanzATX cleans windows here with pure water, and neighbors can book together.

sections.h2: What West Cypress Hills homes are like
paragraphs: West Cypress Hills is large, with roughly 1,000 or more homes and West Cypress Hills Elementary on site, so many families live here for the school and the Lake Travis ISD zoning. Prices run about $500K to $1M. Homes include a range of builders and plans, mostly two story with stone and stucco fronts, covered patios and two or three car garages. There is no gate, and a West Cypress Hills HOA keeps up the common areas. Lots sit on the Hill Country terrain, so some back to greenbelt or hills and others face the street.
Because the community is big and built in phases, the age of homes varies from street to street.

sections.h2: What West Cypress Hills windows deal with
paragraphs: In a master planned community of this size, the common issues repeat: pollen, dust and hard water. Cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April cover the glass. Growing neighborhoods have construction dust from lots still being built, which settles on finished windows. Irrigation systems on smaller lots spray the foundation and lower panes, leaving white spots that can etch the glass over time. Sloped yards and greenbelts bring webs and bugs to the screens.
Afternoon sun on west facing windows highlights streaks and film, so pure water makes a visible difference.

sections.h2: How we work West Cypress Hills
paragraphs: With no gate, we drive right in. The size of the community is good for scheduling: when neighbors on a street book together, we run the whole block in one visit. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, which covers a two story home without ladders. Indoors at West Cypress Hills, panes are hand squeegeed over drop cloths. Many families add screens and tracks, and a driveway or patio wash. Concrete is $0.18 per square foot with a $250 minimum, and we clean patios and pool decks by hand so they do not get soaked.
A 2,600 square foot home is about $260 for exterior windows. Expect two to two and a half hours outside and about an hour and fifteen minutes inside.

faq.q: Do you offer a discount if my neighbors book too?
faq.a: There is no published group discount. What we can do is schedule you the same day, which keeps lead time near two weeks. Plans offer 10% to 20% off.

faq.q: What does a typical home cost?
faq.a: Exterior windows are $10 each or about $0.10 per square foot, so a 2,600 square foot home is about $260. Cleaning inside and out in West Cypress Hills is $15 per window.

faq.q: Can you clean the front windows above the garage?
faq.a: Yes. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so those are covered without a ladder.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: Not for exterior only, as long as we can reach the windows. For interior cleaning someone should be home. We text before we arrive.
For West Cypress Hills homes, screens are $5, full screens $10 and solar screens $15. Cleaning them removes pollen and webs that otherwise blow back on the glass.
